title: Still Watching The Bigfoot Legacy of Salt Fork
original_title: Still Watching The Bigfoot Legacy of Salt Fork
overview: Seth heads to Salt Fork State Park-home of the annual Ohio Bigfoot Conference-to uncover the truth behind one of the most active Sasquatch hotspots in the country. As thousands gather for the event, Seth speaks with veteran researchers, eyewitnesses, and longtime attendees to get a sense of why Salt Fork has earned its reputation as Ohio's Bigfoot capital.
